name: Corpus Browse Lifecycle
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = policy/data context, `(O)` = user-visible operation. Source symbols appear in labels.

                          CORPUS BROWSE AND VERIFICATION

 [D] DomainProfile surface policy - domainProfile.ts:ContentPresentation
       |
       +-- explorer tabs from WorkspaceSurfaceProfile
       `-- ContentPresentation: code/plain, source/terminal Markdown,
             wrapping, source compaction

       +-- [D] SOURCE_CODE_PROFILE: Diagram Files + Diagram Sets; highlighted/unwrapped
       `-- [D] DOCUMENT_PROFILE: Diagram Files + Sections + Highlights; plain/wrapped/terminal
       |
       v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| WORKSPACE ENTRY SURFACES                                                                       |
|                                                                                                |
|  (O) FileExplorerPanel.tsx                                                                     |
|     (O) diagramFileFilter - active artifact Evidence IDs -> normalized live Corpus paths       |
|      load/check directories; exclude unresolved or foreign provenance; build expandable tree   |
|      +-- select explicit file ----------------------------------------------------> DIRECT      |
|      `-- expand file; select Evidence handle + range row ------------------------> MEDIATED    |
|                                                                                                |
|  (O) MarkdownSectionsPanel.tsx                                                                 |
|      build heading tree; map most-specific jumps; expose replay/clear controls                  |
|      `-- select section -> path + target line + section range -------------------> DIRECT      |
|                                                                                                |
|  [D] HighlightRecordV2 - highlights.ts                                                         |
|      artifact revision + mapped element + Evidence ID/range; optional excerpt or lineage       |
|      `-- (O) HighlightsTreePanel.reveal -> restore artifact ---------------------> MEDIATED    |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

explicit file selection --------------------------------------------------------------+
explicit section selection - App.tsx:jumpToMarkdownSection --------------------------+

Evidence row (entity ID + source-range index) --------------------+
Mapped visual claim - App.tsx:revealCodeEntity -------------------+----> MEDIATED
saved highlight - App.tsx:revealHighlight ------------------------+
                                                                  |
                                                                  v
                                                     (O) Evidence-mediated reveal
                                                                  |
                                                                  v
                                                     [D] EvidenceEntity / EvidenceSchema
                                                         stable ID, handle, label, kind, summary,
                                                         Corpus SourceRange anchors
                                                                  |
                                                                  v
                                                     (O) CodeEntitiesPanel range resolution
                                                         select exact range; local -> fetchSourceSnippet
                                                         foreign -> captured original lines

explicit file browse ---------------------------------------------------------+
section source-location jump -------------------------------------------------+----> selected source target
Evidence range resolved ------------------------------------------------------+                 |
                                                                                               v
                                                                    [D] Authoritative Corpus passage
                                                                        user reads and verifies support
                                                                                               |
                                                                                               v
                                                                    (O) ContentPresentation dispatch
                                                                        CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx + file type
                                                                                               |
                                                      +------------------+--------------------+
                                                      |                                       |
                                                      v                                       v
+-- [D] SourceCodeView.tsx:SourceCodeView --+   +-- [D] TerminalMarkdownView.tsx --+
| syntax highlighting or plain              |   | sandboxed rendered Markdown       |
| selected-range scroll/highlight            |   | repository links; target line/range|
| expandable compacted source spans          |   | scroll and passage highlight       |
+--------------------------------------------+   +-----------------------------------+
                                                                 |
                                                                 | outline + active section
(O) outline/active-section feedback: TerminalMarkdownView -> StudioPage -> MarkdownSectionsPanel

direct section / Evidence reveal destinations
       |
       v
(O) PaneNavigationApi - navigation.ts
       |
       +-- activate destination tab and pane
       +-- record recent de-duplicated destinations
       +-- schedule destination-specific scroll/focus handler
       `-- jump replays; clearHistory clears
       |
       v
[D] Recent jump history
       |
       `-- return/replay after Corpus verification; section panel exposes replay + clear

Verification loop:
mapped claim/highlight -> Evidence -> source anchors -> Corpus passage -> history return
explicit file/section  -------------------------------> Corpus passage -> continue browsing
